subject: A deployment needs you
heading: A deployment is waiting for you
stepBody: The deployment {{endpoint}} is waiting for you: a command you run yourself in a terminal on the node (for example one that asks for a sudo password), or a node setting to turn on (its operator terminal) before that command can run.
restartBody: The deployment {{endpoint}} stopped. Its start command is one you run yourself, so WS Model Proxy does not restart it on its own: restart it from the dashboard when you are ready.
footer: You get this email because a deployment you own uses interactive recipe commands. Agents cannot answer these steps for you.
